properties.answer: Committed in the git repo. The bytes travel exactly as the design does — clone and you have everything, nothing to configure, nothing to be down. Accepting repo weight, and that git handles binary churn poorly, as the cost. (Anthony, 2026-07-31.)
properties.context_setter: Nothing satisfies requirement “A pointer resolves for everyone holding the design, not only for the machine that wrote it”
properties.question: If you and your brother are both working on the same design from different machines, the diagrams and notes need to open for both of you — or clearly say they are missing. Should they travel in the git repository alongside the design, or be kept somewhere separate that each person sets up?
